authority.expected_value_provider: independent arithmetic reconstruction of hc_split_sinkhorn, hc_mixes, hc_pre, hc_post

non_claims: does not execute Attention, FFN, or MoE
does not validate layer-to-layer pre_mix carry beyond the reviewed Block.forward source flow
does not validate logits or full model

functions.name: Block.forward
functions.reviewed_pre_mix_flow: Block.forward receives pre_mix from caller for attention hc_pre; attn hc_mixes is computed before attention and its attn_pre is passed to FFN hc_pre; ffn hc_mixes returns ffn_pre to caller for next block attention

operation_contract.hc_mixes: flatten [B,S,hc,d] to [B,S,hc*d] f32; rsqrt over flattened stream; F.linear with F32 hc_fn times rsqrt; split_sinkhorn
operation_contract.hc_post: post*x plus comb-weighted residual copies, return sublayer output dtype
operation_contract.hc_pre: sum over hc copies using pre_mix, return input dtype
operation_contract.hc_split_sinkhorn_order: pre=sigmoid(mix[:hc]*scale[0]+base[:hc])+eps; post=2*sigmoid(mix[hc:2hc]*scale[1]+base[hc:2hc]); comb affine; row softmax + eps; column normalize by col_sum+eps; repeat sinkhorn_iters-1 times: row normalize by row_sum+eps then column normalize by col_sum+eps

purpose: Boundary 6a Hyper-Connections primitive/mixing semantics; stop before Attention/FFN/MoE execution
